controls.FARADAYS_LAW/a11y.summaryDescription: The play area has a light bulb circuit, and a movable bar magnet. There are controls that change what is connected to the circuit,  flip the bar magnet, and reset the sim.
controls.FARADAYS_LAW/a11y.moveMagnetToPlay: Move the magnet to play using arrow keys, W A S D, or 1 2 3 keys.
controls.FARADAYS_LAW/a11y.voltmeterDescription: Play with or without voltmeter connected to light bulb circuit
controls.FARADAYS_LAW/a11y.fieldLinesDescription: Add or remove magnetic field lines.
controls.FARADAYS_LAW/a11y.positionOfPlayAreaPatt: at the {{position}} of the Play Area.
controls.FARADAYS_LAW/a11y.barMagnetHelpText: Use the W A S D keys to move the magnet in four directions. Use 1 2 3 keys to slide magnet left and right.
controls.FARADAYS_LAW/a11y.fieldLinesDescriptionP: Magnetic field lines go around from North end on {{northSide}} side of magnet, to South end on {{southSide}} side of magnet.
controls.FARADAYS_LAW/a11y.fourLoopOnlyFieldStren: From the magnet"s position, a {{fieldStrength}} magnetic field is passing through the 4 loop coil.
controls.FARADAYS_LAW/a11y.magnetPositionExtraAle: Magnet at {{position}} of Play Area. W A S D and 1 2 3 keys moves magnet.
controls.FARADAYS_LAW/a11y.fieldStrengthPassingBo: {{strength}} magnetic field passing through both 4 loop and 2 loop coils.
controls.FARADAYS_LAW/a11y.flippingMagnetPattern: Magnet flipped. North pole on {{northSide}}. South pole on {{southSide}}.
controls.FARADAYS_LAW/a11y.singleCoilDescription: The coil is sideways, with openings on the left and right.
controls.FARADAYS_LAW/a11y.doubleCoilDescription: The coils are sideways, with openings on the left and right.
controls.FARADAYS_LAW/a11y.circuitFourCoilOnly: In circuit are a light bulb and 4 loop coil.
controls.FARADAYS_LAW/a11y.circuitFourCoilAndVolt: In circuit are a light bulb, a 4 loop coil, and a voltmeter.
